verdict.rationale: Canva ships an official hosted MCP server (confirmed live and OAuth-gated in the runtime probe) exposing design generation, editing, discovery, asset/brand-kit access, and export tools, which does give an agent programmatic access to some design context. However, none of the evidence mentions frames, variables, screenshots-as-spec, or component-to-code mappings — Canva's MCP is oriented toward generating/editing marketing designs, not extracting structured design specs for a coding agent to implement UI in code. Missing for 10: evidence of frame/layer-level structure, design tokens/variables, or component mapping data suitable for code implementation.
